claims.text: The paper proposes a new evaluation metric called partial match precision, recall, and F1 score, which measures the overlap between predicted spans and ground truth answers using the longest common substring (LCS).
The evaluation metrics are designed to assess multi-span QA systems across different tasks, reflecting a more realistic QA setup.
